full_prompt_en: A photographic portrait shows an older dark-skinned woman seated upright against a mottled blue-grey wall. She faces the camera with a calm, steady expression, her lined face and long neck clearly visible above layered bead necklaces. An elaborate arrangement of dark textured locks, gold-toned ornaments and wispy brown feather-like strands spreads around and above her head. Its irregular outline is broad rather than smoothly symmetrical. Her fitted jacket is richly covered in small embroidered motifs, beads, contrasting fabric patches and metallic-looking details. Ochre, muted green, brown, dusty blue and small warm accents mingle across the chest and sleeves. Golden-brown fringe fans out from both shoulders. Several necklace strands descend over the patterned front, while decorated cuffs surround the wrists. Her forearms angle inward and her hands rest together at the lower centre, one crossing over the other above a pale beige lower garment. Only a limited area of this quieter fabric is visible at the bottom of the portrait; the seated body is cropped before the full legs and chair can be seen. Small raised stitches, bead clusters and worn fabric surfaces remain distinct within the dense ornament. Behind her, the wall has cloudy patches of lighter grey and darker blue-green, with vertical scuffs and uneven staining. The left and lower background areas are darker, while lighter patches appear behind the head and on the right. Soft light from the front and slightly to the left highlights the forehead, cheeks, hands and warm fringe, with restrained shadows beneath the chin and among the layered decorations. The almost frontal figure, broad head ornament and compact folded hands form a composed vertical arrangement, contrasting the intricate earthy clothing with the subdued textured wall.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅摄影肖像，一位年长深肤色女子端坐在斑驳蓝灰墙前。她平静而稳定地看向镜头，带有细纹的脸和修长颈部在层叠珠链上方清楚可见。深色纹理发束、金色饰件与棕色羽毛般的细丝在头顶及两侧展开，宽阔外缘不规则，并非光滑对称。合身外套覆盖密集刺绣小纹样、珠饰、对比布片和近似金属的细节。赭色、柔和绿、棕色、灰蓝与小块暖色交织于胸前和袖管。金棕穗饰从两肩向外散开。多道珠链垂过图案前襟，装饰袖口环住手腕。前臂向内倾斜，双手在下方中央相叠，停在浅米色下装上方。较安静的浅色布料仅在肖像底部露出有限一片，坐姿身体在完整腿部和座椅出现前被裁切。密集装饰中，细小凸针脚、珠簇与旧布表面仍彼此可辨。人物背后墙面带有云状浅灰斑块、较深蓝绿区域、竖向擦痕和不均匀污渍。左侧及下方背景较暗，头后与右侧有较亮色块。来自正面略偏左的柔光点亮额头、脸颊、双手和暖色穗饰，下巴下方及层叠装饰之间保留克制阴影。近乎正面的身体、宽阔头饰和紧凑交叠双手组成沉稳竖向结构，让繁密土色服装与含蓄斑驳墙面形成对照。
style_prompt_en: The style combines photographic detail, richly layered tactile surfaces and a restrained earthy palette. Ochre, brown, muted green and small jewel-colour accents stand against mottled blue-grey. Fine raised ornament, matte worn areas and small reflective points remain individually readable within dense patterning. Soft frontal light with a slight lateral bias models the main volume, while gentle shadows preserve the depth of overlapping layers. An irregular cloudy background adds texture without competing with the central form. The composition is frontal and vertically organized, with broad upper shapes balanced by a compact lower grouping, creating a composed and quietly formal effect.
style_prompt_zh: 这种风格结合摄影细节、丰富层叠触感与克制土色色谱。赭色、棕色、柔和绿调和少量宝石色点缀衬在斑驳蓝灰底上。细小浮起装饰、哑光磨损区域与微小反光点，在密集纹样内部仍分别可辨。略带侧向的正面柔光塑造主要体积，轻柔阴影保留重叠层次的深度。不规则云状背景增添纹理，却不争夺中央形体的注意力。构图正面展开并沿竖向组织，上部宽形与下部紧凑组合互相平衡，形成沉稳、安静而正式的效果。
theme_en: An older woman in an ornate embroidered outfit against a textured blue-grey wall
theme_zh: 斑驳蓝灰墙前身穿繁饰刺绣服装的年长女子
name: Phyllis Galembo
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
